summary:
Claim for flight W62301 on 2026-10-18 (BUD→TIA).
Result: ELIGIBLE for EUR 250.
Why: Covered: the flight departed from Budapest, inside the EU261 area. Distance 670 km: EUR 250 band. Airline reason 'CREW_STRIKE' does not excuse the airline: a strike by the airline's own staff is not extraordinary (CJEU C-28/20). The passenger was told only 2 day(s) ahead (less than 7).
Status: waiting for human review.
Next step: A claims handler must approve the drafted letter before it is sent.

letter.subject: EU261 compensation claim - flight W62301 on 2026-10-18
letter.body:
Dear Wizz Air Customer Relations,

We act on behalf of our client regarding flight W62301 on 2026-10-18 from Budapest (BUD) to Tirana (TIA), which was cancelled at short notice.

Under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, Articles 5, 7 and the case law of the Court of Justice of the EU, the passenger is entitled to compensation of EUR 250 for this cancellation. The flight distance is 670 km.

Based on the information available to us, no extraordinary circumstances apply.

Please pay EUR 250 within 14 days of this letter and send your reply to our claims team.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Team
